column3:
Munyeta area “the food basket” is located in Kabuyu Ward where
farming is main economic stay, hence a proper road network to connect
such a productive area becomes paramount. The road has only three (3)
major crossing points and becomes impassable during the rainy season.
This makes it difficult for farmers to transport their produce and the
community to access social services such as schools, clinics, police posts.

The road is located on the North-Eastern part of the district in Shikabeta
Ward and is only passable during dry season. It has fourteen (14) crossing
points with no culverts or bridges installed

This area is located on the Northern part of the district. The road has a
poor section approximately 50 meters off the great east road, leaving it
impassable and poses a challenge to access other areas such as Chomba
as well as Lubalashi.

Shimunguwo is located on the eastern part of the district along the banks
of Luangwa River in Mankhanda Ward. During rainy season the
community relies on water transport to access most social services as the
roads become so impassable.

Chipeketi area in Chintimbwi Ward has a poor road network and is
unmotorable during the rainy season resulting in communities covering
over 22km to access health service. The Road lacks and some crossing
points have poor culverts/bridges.

Kamwesha area located within Chintimbwi Ward has a poor road
network which worsens during rainy season. This inhibits the provision
of adequate social services such as water supply.

Chintili in Kankumba Ward has a poor road network during the rainy
season thus posing a challenge for the community to access social
services
